lessons.lesson: Use -rr to keep the application alive after the macro. Automated tests use -z hidden views to avoid interactive startup tips.
The socket handler queues work; only the Qt main-thread timer accesses GUI layout objects.
Inspect again after a manual edit. Geometry/properties fingerprints reject a stale target even when the source file is unchanged.
Bridge save creates a private new GDS snapshot; it neither overwrites the original nor clears the GUI document's modified state.
A successful synthetic width-rule test proves tool/report plumbing, not foundry DRC coverage.
